global: This is a rich, creamy tonkotsu ramen broth, topped with tender chashu pork, nori, and menma, arranged neatly in a red-and-white patterned bowl. Warm lighting highlights the meal on a wooden table, with chopsticks and spoon resting beside it.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu broth with noodles appears creamy, pale orange, and rich, with visible green onions and a slice of chashu pork resting atop.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly worn edges.
regions.chopsticks: Black chopsticks with smooth, slightly glossy surface, tapered ends, and subtle wear marks visible.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed, dark brown, textured, irregularly shaped, with visible surface ridges and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a round, pinkish-brown slice with visible fat marbling and green onion garnish on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly curled, with visible fibrous texture and faint green specks on their surface.
